digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud and Data Center adapters
propositions: Cloud and Data Center Jira adapters lack symmetric test coverage despite sharing a backend port, with Cloud having battle-tested byte-for-byte characterization but DC having pagination and rate-limit proofs that Cloud lacks
DC adapter field values, sanitizer boundaries, and identity label form are not pinned by value in tests, creating confidence gaps for shipped DC functionality
The ticket-type field map is duplicated across adapters without a single-source guard, unlike existing status and priority map guards
DC comment and description length convergence behavior has not been validated across multiple passes, and the comment ceiling constant lacks provenance documentation
Cloud adapter has untested multi-page reader behavior and potential truncation risks that DC discovered through live testing against differently-configured instances
